items.title: Pandas 3.0
items.raw_content: We're excited to announce the release of pandas 3.0.0. This major long-awaited release brings significant improvements to pandas, but also features some potentially breaking changes. Further, pandas 3.0 includes a lot of other improvements and bug fixes. You can find the complete list of changes in the release notes .
items.title_zh: Pandas 3.0 发布
items.summary: The pandas project announced version 3.0.0, a long-awaited major release with significant improvements, some potentially breaking changes, and many other improvements and bug fixes.

items.title: A decentralized peer-to-peer messaging application that operates over Bluetooth
items.title_zh: 一款通过蓝牙运行的去中心化点对点通信应用
items.summary: bitchat is a decentralized peer-to-peer messaging application that runs over Bluetooth mesh networks without internet, servers or phone numbers. Each device acts as both client and server and relays messages across multiple hops.

items.title: San Francisco coyote swims to Alcatraz
items.title_zh: 旧金山一只郊狼游到恶魔岛
items.summary: SFGATE reports that a San Francisco coyote swam to Alcatraz, with park biologists saying it was the first time they had observed anything like it.

items.title: Danish pension fund divesting US Treasuries
items.title_zh: 丹麦养老基金减持美国国债
items.summary: Reuters reports that a Danish pension fund is divesting its US Treasuries.

items.title: The Overcomplexity of the Shadcn Radio Button
items.title_zh: Shadcn 单选按钮的过度复杂化
items.summary: The post questions why a built-in browser radio button is rebuilt through a UI library wrapping another UI library, pulling in several kilobytes of JavaScript and multiple dependencies.

items.title: How AI destroys institutions
items.title_zh: AI 如何摧毁制度
items.summary: A Stanford publication argues that civic institutions such as the rule of law, universities, and a free press are the backbone of democratic life, with their ability to evolve and adapt described as their real strength.

items.title: Your brain on ChatGPT: Accumulation of cognitive debt when using an AI assistant
items.title_zh: ChatGPT 与大脑：使用 AI 助手会累积“认知债务”
items.summary: An MIT Media Lab study examined the neural and behavioral consequences of essay writing with LLM assistance, dividing participants into three groups including one that used an LLM and one that used a search engine.

items.title: I was banned from Claude for scaffolding a Claude.md file?
items.title_zh: 我因为创建 Claude.md 文件被 Claude 封禁了？
items.summary: A blog post asks whether its author was banned from Claude for scaffolding a Claude.md file.

items.title: Tree-sitter vs. Language Servers
items.title_zh: Tree-sitter 与语言服务器
items.summary: The post describes Tree-sitter as a fast parser generator that tolerates syntax errors, making it well suited to syntax highlighting, and contrasts it with language servers from a pragmatic standpoint.

items.title: Microsoft mishandling example.com
items.title_zh: Microsoft 对 example.com 的处理失误
items.summary: A blog post reports that since at least February 2020 Microsoft's Autodiscover service has incorrectly routed the IANA-reserved example.com domain to Sumitomo Electric Industries' mail servers at sei.co.jp, potentially sending test credentials there. It says Outlook on Windows and macOS auto-configured a dummy email@example.com account to those IMAP and SMTP hosts.

items.title: BirdyChat becomes first European chat app that is interoperable with WhatsApp
items.title_zh: BirdyChat 成为首个与 WhatsApp 互通的欧洲聊天应用
items.summary: BirdyChat's blog announces that Balsio, its chat app, is the first in Europe able to exchange messages with WhatsApp under the Digital Markets Act.

items.title: Man shot and killed by federal agents in south Minneapolis this morning
items.title_zh: 一名男子今晨在明尼阿波利斯南部被联邦探员枪杀
items.summary: A local report says a man was shot and killed by federal agents in south Minneapolis that morning.

items.title: A flawed paper in management science has been cited more than 6k times
items.title_zh: 一篇有缺陷的管理学论文被引用超过 6000 次
items.summary: A blog post examines a management-science paper described as flawed that has been cited more than 6,000 times.

items.title: Nvidia-smi hangs indefinitely after ~66 days
items.title_zh: nvidia-smi 在运行约 66 天后无限挂起
items.summary: A GitHub issue reports that nvidia-smi hangs indefinitely after roughly 66 days, alongside a dump of NVIDIA open GPU kernel module parameters.

items.title: Yes, It's Fascism
items.title_zh: 是的，这就是法西斯主义
items.summary: An Atlantic essay argues that the political situation in the United States is fascism.

items.summary: According to a report on the Swedish electronics site ETN, the cURL project has removed its bug bounty program.

items.title: Xiaomi reportedly to build second in-house flagship chip on TSMC 3nm, skip 2nm node
items.title_zh: 小米据报将在台积电 3nm 工艺上打造第二代自研旗舰芯片，跳过 2nm
items.summary: Xiaomi's second-generation in-house flagship mobile processor, the Xring O2, will reportedly be manufactured using TSMC's 3-nanometre N3P process rather than a 2nm node, according to TechNode.

items.title: Unitree granted two humanoid robot design patents, ships over 5,500 units in 2025
items.title_zh: 宇树获批两项人形机器人外观设计专利，2025 年出货超 5,500 台
items.summary: Unitree Robotics, a Chinese robotics company, has obtained two humanoid robot design patents, per the latest public disclosures.

items.title: Inside Makera’s bet on global makers as desktop CNC power finds its moment
items.title_zh: Makera 押注全球创客：桌面 CNC 正迎来自己的时刻
items.summary: TechNode profiles Makera's bet on global makers amid the growing accessibility of digital manufacturing technology and desktop-level tools for creators and small businesses.

items.title: Sony, TCL Plan Home Entertainment JV, TCL to Take 51% Stake
items.title_zh: 索尼与 TCL 拟组建家庭娱乐合资公司，TCL 将持股 51%
items.summary: Sony has signed a memorandum of understanding with TCL Electronics to form a global joint venture for their TV and home-entertainment businesses, with TCL to take a 51% stake, according to TechNode.

items.title: BOE production problems force Apple to shift iPhone OLED orders to Samsung Display, sources say
items.title_zh: 消息称 BOE 生产问题迫使苹果将 iPhone OLED 订单转给三星显示
items.summary: Citing sources, the report says production problems at BOE forced Apple to shift iPhone OLED orders to Samsung Display.

items.title: Vivo halts AI glasses project over lack of product differentiation
items.title_zh: Vivo 因产品缺乏差异化暂停 AI 眼镜项目
items.summary: Chinese smartphone maker Vivo halted its AI glasses project after concluding it would be difficult to differentiate the product in a crowded market.

items.title: Exploring physical AI: Linkerbot works on giving robots human-like hands to act in the real world
items.title_zh: 探索物理 AI：Linkerbot 为机器人打造类人双手，让其在现实世界中行动
items.summary: A TechNode article on physical AI that frames dexterous robotic hands as the bodies of machines whose brains are large language models, as AI steps out of the digital world into the physical one.

items.title: Augani/openreel-video
items.title_zh: Augani/openreel-video
items.summary: OpenReel Video is an open-source, browser-based video editor positioned as a CapCut alternative, with no installation, cloud uploads or watermarks. It is written in TypeScript.

items.title: WordPress/agent-skills
items.title_zh: WordPress/agent-skills：面向 AI 编程助手的 WordPress 技能
items.summary: A JavaScript repository that provides WordPress knowledge for AI coding assistants, covering blocks, themes, plugins and best practices.

items.title: AvdLee/SwiftUI-Agent-Skill
items.title_zh: AvdLee/SwiftUI-Agent-Skill：为 AI 编程工具提供 SwiftUI 最佳实践
items.summary: A project that adds expert SwiftUI best-practice guidance to AI coding tools through the open Agent Skills format.

items.title: flybirdxx/ComfyUI-Qwen-TTS
items.title_zh: ComfyUI-Qwen-TTS：Qwen3-TTS 的 ComfyUI 简易实现
items.summary: The repository is a simple ComfyUI implementation of Qwen3-TTS, written in Python.

items.title: anthropics/knowledge-work-plugins
items.title_zh: anthropics/knowledge-work-plugins：面向知识工作者的 Claude Cowork 插件集
items.summary: An open-source Python repository of plugins intended mainly for knowledge workers to use in Claude Cowork.

items.title: Lingyan000/fluxdo
items.title_zh: Lingyan000/fluxdo：Linux.do 第三方客户端
items.summary: A third-party client for Linux.do written in Dart.

items.title: ColeMurray/background-agents
items.title_zh: background-agents：开源后台智能体编码系统
items.summary: An open-source coding system built around background agents, written in TypeScript.

items.title: rivet-dev/agents
items.title_zh: rivet-dev/agents：为每个智能体提供持久进程
items.summary: A TypeScript project that gives each agent a durable process with memory that survives restarts.

items.title: qufei1993/skills-hub
items.title_zh: skills-hub：统一管理与同步 Agent Skills 的跨平台桌面应用
items.summary: A cross-platform desktop app written in Rust that manages Agent Skills in one place and syncs them to the global skills directories of multiple AI coding tools.

items.title: LLM Security and Safety: Insights from Homotopy-Inspired Prompt Obfuscation
items.title_zh: LLM 安全与保障：同伦启发式提示混淆的洞见
items.summary: The paper proposes a homotopy-inspired prompt obfuscation framework for studying LLM security and safety, testing 15,732 prompts, including 10,000 high-priority cases, across Llama, DeepSeek, KIMI and Claude.

items.title: A Learnable Wavelet Transformer for Long-Short Equity Trading and Risk-Adjusted Return Optimization
items.title_zh: 面向多空股票交易与风险调整收益优化的可学习小波 Transformer
items.summary: The paper proposes WaveLSFormer, a learnable wavelet-based Transformer that directly outputs a market-neutral long/short portfolio and is trained end-to-end on a trading objective. Over five years of hourly data across six industry groups, it reports an average cumulative strategy return of 0.607 and a Sharpe ratio of 2.157.

items.title: Towards Execution-Grounded Automated AI Research
items.title_zh: 迈向以执行反馈为基础的自动化 AI 研究
items.summary: The study builds an automated executor that implements ideas and runs large-scale parallel GPU experiments, then compares evolutionary search and reinforcement learning as ways to learn from execution feedback on LLM pre-training and post-training. Execution-guided evolutionary search beat the GRPO and nanoGPT baselines within ten search epochs, while reinforcement learning improved average reward but suffered mode collapse.

items.title: Identity, Cooperation and Framing Effects within Groups of Real and Simulated Humans
items.title_zh: 真实与模拟人类群体中的身份、合作与框架效应
items.summary: The paper studies how LLMs simulate human behavior in social-dilemma games and finds that conditioning base models with rich narrative identities improves fidelity to human studies, while LLMs can also model contextual factors such as time, question framing, and participant-pool effects.

items.title: SpecBridge: Bridging Mass Spectrometry and Molecular Representations via Cross-Modal Alignment
items.title_zh: SpecBridge：通过跨模态对齐连接质谱与分子表示
items.summary: SpecBridge is an implicit alignment framework that fine-tunes a self-supervised spectral encoder (DreaMS) to project into the latent space of a frozen molecular foundation model (ChemBERTa), then retrieves candidates by cosine similarity. Across MassSpecGym, Spectraverse and MSnLib it improves top-1 retrieval accuracy by roughly 20-25% over strong neural baselines while keeping trainable parameters small, and the code is released on GitHub.

items.title: TabularMath: Evaluating Computational Extrapolation in Tabular Learning via Program-Verified Synthesis
items.title_zh: TabularMath：通过程序验证合成评估表格学习中的计算外推
items.summary: The authors introduce TabularMath, a diagnostic benchmark of 114 deterministic problems totalling 233,472 rows and generated from verified programs based on GSM8K and AIME; TabPFN v2.5 reaches R²=0.998 in-distribution but falls below 10% rounded consistency out of distribution, while in-context learning with GPT-OSS-120B stays around 40%.

items.title: On the Runway Cascade of Transformers for Language Modeling
items.title_zh: 语言建模中 Transformer 的跑道级联
items.summary: The paper links certain failure modes of causal transformers to a runway cascade, in which indirect paths through intermediate tokens carry redundant or irrelevant information into token representations.

items.title: Reconstructing Protected Biometric Templates from Binary Authentication Results
items.title_zh: 从二元认证结果重建受保护的生物特征模板
items.summary: The paper shows that an attacker who can inject biometric samples and observe only whether authentication succeeds can reconstruct protected biometric templates with negligible reconstruction loss. Using a generative inversion method, the authors recover high-resolution facial images that pass the system more than 98% of the time.
